output.content: NVIDIA’s gross margin in Q2 fiscal 2027 (quarter ended July 26, 2026) was **75.0% on both a GAAP and non-GAAP basis**; GAAP gross profit was **$72.142 billion** on **$96.2 billion** of revenue. [[1]]
